changes: Measured contact/ownership/display box separated from collision envelope
Native seal plane independently bound to measured box inside envelope
Collision, attached motion, rest and release use full envelope; inertia uses measured dimensions and explicit COM offset

synthetic_scan.over_6mm_reason: Foreshortened side-plane pixels span more metric depth than front pixels; the per-axis footprint plus 3 mm noise allowance and observed noisy extrema are retained. No 6 mm cap that could cut off true geometry was applied.
synthetic_scan.missing_edge_basis: Union of possible boxes with maximum edge 0.40 m; union size can exceed one possible carton size

support.limitation: A support not exactly parallel to an OBB face requires a clipped payload; this implementation rejects MEASURED_SUPPORT_REQUIRES_CLIPPED_ENVELOPE rather than penetrate support or cut possible carton corners.

size_semantics.target_point_ownership: measured_box plus existing margins; other instance masks excluded
size_semantics.detach_supports: collision_envelope bottom only with measured support evidence
size_semantics.mass_inertia: configured mass and measured cuboid COM/inertia estimate, expressed in envelope axes

baseline_failure: Same axis-sensitive prior fixture reproduced on 265b29f; see step 1 evidence
